s001-critical.evidence: The circular outline is continuous; the upper-right quarter sector has clean edges and clear surrounding space.

s001-craft.evidence: Smooth concentric curves, consistent outline weight and crisp radial edges.

s001-native.evidence: Both the outer ring and quarter sector remain distinguishable at 1x on light and dark.

s001-recognition.evidence: A circular indicator with one quarter filled, suggesting time or progress.

s001-ship.evidence: The geometry is polished and its defining sector survives native rendering.

s002-critical.evidence: The enclosing badge and bottom point are continuous; the bear-like head remains separated from the frame.

s002-craft.evidence: Balanced rounded frame, controlled bottom point and symmetrical head silhouette with clean ear joins.

s002-native.evidence: The pointed badge, inner head and ear bumps remain visible on both backgrounds at 1x.

s002-recognition.evidence: A bear head inside a pointed badge or map marker.

s002-ship.evidence: The enclosure and animal silhouette are clean, balanced and legible.

s003-critical.evidence: The upper and lower dashes are regularly separated; the central horizontal stroke is intact.

s003-native.evidence: The solid middle line and both dashed rows stay distinct at 1x in both themes.

s003-recognition.evidence: A solid horizontal line between two dashed rows; a divider or row-formatting symbol, but the exact operation is unclear.

s003-ship.evidence: The abstract line symbol has professional geometry and clear native rendering.
s003-ship.treatment: No contour change necessary; label its function.

s004-craft.evidence: The rounded handle and blade curve are smooth, but abrupt flat cuts disrupt the otherwise continuous outline.
s004-craft.treatment: Repair the central breaks and reconcile the joins.

s004-native.evidence: At 1x the separated fragments do not form a reliably readable tool silhouette on either background.
s004-native.treatment: Restore contour continuity and reassess at native size.

s004-recognition.evidence: A handled triangular blade, possibly a trowel or cleaver; the central interruption obscures the object.
s004-recognition.treatment: Repair the silhouette before assessing recognition again.

s004-ship.evidence: The two aligned contour breaks look like missing geometry and weaken recognition.

s005-critical.evidence: The balloon outline is closed, the highlight is intentionally detached, and the small knot retains an opening.

s005-craft.evidence: Smooth balloon contour and rounded highlight; the knot junction is slightly dense relative to the spacious body.

s005-native.evidence: The balloon body, highlight and small lower knot remain readable at 1x on both backgrounds.

s006-critical.evidence: The upper circular node and lower connecting arc terminate abruptly along the same vertical right edge.

s006-craft.treatment: Complete the contours and rebalance the full symbol.

s006-native.evidence: At 1x both themes show disconnected hooks and a loop without a coherent overall symbol.

s008-craft.evidence: Rounded terminals are consistent, but the oversized disk creates a heavy central mass and an awkward fused junction.
